keep.text: Aap log starch, sugar galat use kar rahe ho.
Aur aap logon ko pata bhi nahi hai.
Mere par-dada ko bhi diabetes tha, mere dada ko bhi diabetes tha,
meri dadi ko bhi diabetes tha,
mere papa bhi pre-diabetic hain.
Aur aaj ke time pe main 35 saal ka ho gaya hoon
aur mujhe diabetes ka koi naam-o-nishaan nahi hai.
Aap sochte ho ye sirf aur sirf sugar hai.
Aap sochte ho ki abhi khaaya, energy mili, khatam. Magar ekdam galat baat hai ye.
Ye sugar aapki body mein jaa karke proteins pe chipak jaati hai, aur ye chipakti hai permanently
aur kabhi nahi utarti hai.
Is process ka naam hai glycation, aur chemistry mein isko kehte hain Maillard reaction. 1912 mein
ye discover hua tha. Aur ye wahi reaction hai jo roti ko brown karta hai. Sugar plus protein plus heat is equal to brown roti.
Wahi reaction aapki body mein bhi ho raha hai.
Slowly ho raha hai, decades mein ho raha hai, but ho raha hai.
Glucose aapke blood mein hai, wo lysine aur arginine amino acid par chipka hua hai,
ek Schiff base banata hai, Amadori product banata hai, phir AGEs
badhti chali jaati hain aap logon ki, aur advanced glycation end product yahin se banta hai.
Aur ye permanently irreversible hai.
Aur ye AGEs ek receptor activate karte hain, RAGE naam ka, jisko kehte hain receptor of advanced glycation end product, aur naam hai iska RAGE, sahi naam hai.
RAGE activate hone se NF-kB pathway on ho jaata hai, aur yahi ek chronic inflammation jo hoti hai body mein, jiske through cancer hota hai,
usko activate kar deta hai.
Collagen pe chipka hua hai
toh wrinkles hona shuru ho jaayenge. Blood vessels par chipka hua hai toh BP badh jaayega.
Aur
aankhon pe chipka hua hai toh cataract jo hai wo badh jaayenge. Haemoglobin pe hai toh HbA1c test jo karaate ho aap log
isi ke liye toh karaate ho.
Sirf ek aadat hai jo aapki body ko poora ka poora barbaad kar rahi hai, aur wo hai hidden sugar.
Ketchup mein 4 gram hai, healthy juice mein aap logon ke 25-30 gram hai, bread mein 3-6 gram hai.
Aur aap logon ko pata bhi nahi hai.
Doctor ne mujhe 16 saal ki age mein kaha tha ki aap logon ki poori family mein
sabko diabetes hai, aapko bhi 25 se 30 saal mein diabetes ho jaayegi.
Aaj main 35 ka hoon
aur
mera HbA1c perfect hai. Kaise hai?
Main batata hoon.
Glycation reverse nahi hoti hai,
lekin roki ja sakti hai. Kaise?
Health protocol mein maine yahi saari cheezein batayi hain, step by step.
Aur
main koi mazaak ki baat nahi kar raha hoon. Agar aap logon ne apni lifestyle aaj ke time se sudhaar li, toh aap logon ko bhi
kabhi bhi diabetes nahi hoga, poori zindagi bhar diabetes nahi hoga, bhale hi aap logon ke poore
tree mein
sabko diabetes ho rakha ho, magar aap logon ko diabetes nahi hoga.
Aap apne aapko cure kar sakte ho agar aap log apni lifestyle sahi rakhein toh.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana,
decision aapka hai.
